def find_keyword(text, keyword, start=0):
    m = re.search(re.escape(keyword), text[start:], flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return None if m is None else start + m.start()

def split_sentence(sentence):
    if sentence is None:
        return None, None, None
    
    s = str(sentence)
    added_idx = find_keyword(s, "Added", 0)
    if added_idx is None:
        return None, None, None
    
    due_idx = find_keyword(s, "Due", added_idx + len("Added"))
    if due_idx is None:
        return None, None, None
    
    name_raw = s[:added_idx]
    added_raw = s[added_idx + len("Added"):due_idx]
    due_raw = s[due_idx + len("Due"):]
    
    # Match the example row behavior: name keeps original spacing before Added;
    # added date removes only leading separator spacing but keeps trailing separator spacing.
    name_part = name_raw
    added_part = added_raw.lstrip(" \t\r\n\u00a0")
    due_part = due_raw.strip(" \t\r\n\u00a0")
    
    return name_part, added_part, due_part

def parse_date(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    
    text = str(value).replace("\u00a0", " ").strip()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    
    month_map = {
        "jan": 1, "january": 1,
        "feb": 2, "february": 2,
        "mar": 3, "march": 3,
        "apr": 4, "april": 4,
        "may": 5,
        "jun": 6, "june": 6,
        "jul": 7, "july": 7,
        "aug": 8, "august": 8,
        "sep": 9, "sept": 9, "september": 9,
        "oct": 10, "october": 10,
        "nov": 11, "november": 11,
        "dec": 12, "december": 12,
    }
    
    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\.?,?\s*(\d{4})?", text)
    if not m:
        return value
    
    day = int(m.group(1))
    month_name = m.group(2).lower()
    year = int(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 2021
    
    if month_name not in month_map:
        return value
    
    return datetime(year, month_map[month_name], day)

# Infer whether the example added date column is stored as text or a real date.
example_added = ws["D4"].value
example_due = ws["E4"].value

added_should_be_date = isinstance(example_added, datetime)
due_should_be_date = isinstance(example_due, datetime)

# Fill only the requested answer cells C5:E6.

        ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = None
        ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = None
        continue
    
    ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value = name_part
    ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = parse_date(added_part) if added_should_be_date else added_part
    ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = parse_date(due_part) if due_should_be_date else due_part

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
